name: Scene Contraction Function
definition: A function that bounds the scene into a cube of size 2, which is then reduced to a cube of size 1 for coding implementation reasons. It uses the L-infinity norm rather than L2 to bound the position to a cube rather than a sphere, which is convenient with grid-based representations.
summary: The Scene Contraction Function maps unbounded 3D scenes into a bounded unit cube using the L-infinity norm, enabling efficient multiresolution grid storage for both near and far fields.
